newsitem.title: UK: BP sees full Cusiana output by February 1997.
newsitem.headline: BP sees full Cusiana output by February 1997.

text.p: British Petroleum Co Plc said on Tuesday it expected to see full 500,000 barrel a day (bpd) capacity from its Cusiana-Cupiagua development in Colombia within the first six weeks of next year.
BP Exploration chief executive Rodney Chase said output from a second phase of the project came onstream a month ago but that the schedule for full output had been delayed a little.
"We hoped to have that 500,000 of production before the end of this year. I think we'll be some four to six weeks late," Chase told reporters after BP announced quarterly results.
BP completed the Ocensa pipeline -- the largest in Colombia -- to allow it to increase production from a first phase of 180,000 bpd. Output now was running at 215,000 bpd, Chase said.
